# HybridInference gateway model listings with effort metadata

`openai.json` (`GET /v1/models`, bearer key) and `anthropic.json`
(`GET /v1/models` with `anthropic-version`) are the gateway's own answers,
generated by its router code from the test registry in
`tests/servers/test_model_effort_capabilities.py` of
HarvardMadSys/hybridInference (branch `codex/fix/model-effort-capabilities`),
where a test pins them byte for byte. Copied here unchanged; the cloud agent's
tests read them as what such a gateway answers.

The registry is a test configuration. `deepseek-like-reasoner` imitates a
DeepSeek-like model behind an OpenAI-compatible route, but its domain
(`high`, `max`) is declared by that test, not taken from DeepSeek or from any
deployment. Nothing here was read from a real provider or deployment.
